verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 software stack documents Docker Engine and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and NVIDIA markets the system for training and inference workloads, which implies containerized framework workloads. However, nothing in the pack names PyTorch or any other ML framework, an official build, or a support matrix. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX support statements, officially documented framework builds or NGC containers for B200, CUDA/driver/framework compatibility matrices, and hands-on community confirmation of frameworks running on B200.
